title: Topologically faithful image segmentation via induced matching of persistence barcodes (Betti matching)
mechanism: Persistent-homology loss that matches predicted and label barcode features by their induced spatial correspondence, then penalises unmatched or shifted features. The efficient C++ version is arxiv:2407.04683.
adaptation: Crack class, 0-dimensional features. Compute it only on label components >= 20 px so that tiny label fragments (76 to 88% of components) are not enforced. Could raise the share of components found (0.798).
min_experiment: Arm: PF + Betti matching (crack, w 0.1, last 10k steps), 3 seeds screen then 5. Baseline: PF. Metric: component recall >= 20 px, crack IoU. Kill if component recall gain < 0.02 or crack IoU < baseline - 0.012.
evidence: R (web summary of abstract): better topology on six datasets with volumetric performance kept. TopoMortar shows a different PH loss (TopoLoss) dropping CrackTree Dice to 0.52.
prior_overlap: none. No PH loss was run here.
